answer: Each identity bonds 70 credits for an island glacier station, drills an ice core, filing a key-signed dust record per epoch. Comet apparitions leave dated bands in glacier ice; the comet-horizon table maps depths to comet dust. Auditors check records against the table: wrong-depth claims, or comet-depth claims without comet dust, burn the bond. Drilling costs rise per funder: first 28, k-th 28+5(k-1), 1000th 5023, 1000 fakes 2,525,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-core ring fails: one core resold to many files duplicate records. An honest identity drills once for 28, keeping its bond.
